name: bb-n105-warm-drum-bus
description: Warm, tight Neve drum-bus tone from the KIT BB N105 V2 (Blackbird Neve channel). Warmth comes from the MIC-mode transformer drive (pre_amp_mode='Mic' + saturation, sensitivity -42 = gentle transformer color, trims sub + adds upper-harmonic sheen) — NOT from an EQ air boost (the user's preference: warm via the transformer, not bright EQ). EQ only tightens: 47 Hz HPF + 56 Hz low shelf +2 for weight + 470 Hz -2 to de-box. HF EQ left OFF so the only top lift is the transformer's own harmonics. Output -13 dB compensates the Mic drive (Auto-gain is GUI-only, unavailable headless). For a brighter/airier 'Neve air' variant, add high_frequency='15 kHz', high_mode='Shelf', high_gain=2.0 (measured +845 Hz centroid, +3 dB shelf above 5 kHz). Built & verified 2026-06-03 on the watercolors drum bus.
intended_for: a stereo drum bus, roughly -18 LUFS balanced. The Mic-drive saturation is level-dependent — on a hotter/quieter bus, re-tune pre_amp_sensitivity (toward -70 = more gain/drive) and output_gain to compensate.
plugin_build: KIT BB N105 V2.vst3 — KIT Plugins, iLok/machine-authorized on this Mac; RENDERS headless via Pedalboard (verified, not just loads). Distinct from KIT BB N73 (=Neve 1073).

target_signature.comment: measured dry->processed on projects/watercolors/mix/bus_warm_pre_dry.wav (full bus, stemmy measure-loudness/spectrum). Dry: crest 23.6, centroid 3128, tilt -2.26, low 0.542, low_mid 0.378, high 0.0115. Sanity-check a re-apply.

notes: ALL params are enum-valued in Pedalboard. Numeric gains (low_gain/high_gain/output_gain/pre_amp_sensitivity) accept a float (coerced to the nearest 0.1 step). But frequencies ('56 Hz','15 kHz'), modes ('Shelf'/'Peak'/'Mic'/'Line'), Hi-Q, phase, eq, saturation are STRING/bool enums — apply-vst-chain's float-only dict cannot set them, so use this preset harness.

The Neve preamp COLOR is MIC-MODE ONLY. In Line mode, pre_amp_sensitivity and pre_amp_saturation are inert (measured byte-identical). Mic mode adds real gain (sens -70 = max, ~+16 dB over -15) and a gentle transformer saturation that grows with drive.

There is NO host Auto-gain param (the GUI 'Auto-gain' button is not exposed). Driving Mic sensitivity raises level a lot — compensate with output_gain (measured exactly linear) and/or the harness peak-trim.
HF EQ band tops out at 15 kHz (steps OFF/15/10/6.8/4.7/3.3 kHz). 12 kHz exists only on the LPF, not the HF EQ.
analog (hum) is negligible offline and left off here. Apply: ../stemmy-loops-mcp/.venv/bin/python presets/vst/apply_vst_preset.py presets/vst/bb-n105-warm-drum-bus.json <in.wav> <out.wav>
